about: What earlier gt releases installed into ~/.claude/golden-thread/hooks/ or wired into settings.json that this release no longer does. install.sh removes exactly these (after a backup) so an upgrade converges on a fresh install; a hooks-dir file or hook entry listed nowhere here is unknown and is left in place. Cumulative: an entry stays for as long as any release that shipped it can still be upgraded from. A file removed from hooks/ (or from HOOK_DIR_SCRIPTS) must be added here in the same release. Derived 2026-09-14 from git history of golden-thread/*/hooks, HOOK_DIR_SCRIPTS and HOOK_REGISTRATIONS across 0.5.0-0.12.9.

hook_files.note: removed from hooks/ in 0.12.8 (it shipped twice); still installed from scripts/gt_paths.py, so install.sh must not delete it while the release ships it

never installed by any release: git history shows it in no hooks/ dir, no HOOK_DIR_SCRIPTS and no install.sh copy list. Found 2026-09-28 in ~/.claude/golden-thread/hooks/ dated 2026-08-29 (the 0.9.4 release day), byte-identical to scripts/gt_ingest.py as shipped 0.6.0-0.9.13 -- most likely a hand copy. Nothing runs it from the hooks dir (the gt-ingest skill runs the cache copy), so install.sh removes it after a backup
